description: Drum synthesizer for 909 style kicks, and for toms, simple snares and hats, with an oscillator section and a noise section, each with its own envelope, level and modulation slot

params.text: Sets the output level of the oscillator section
Sets the output level of the noise section
Sets the rising rate of the oscillator envelope
Sets the time the oscillator envelope stays at its maximum
Sets the rate at which the oscillator envelope returns to 0V
Sets the rising rate of the noise envelope
Sets the time the noise envelope stays at its maximum
Sets the rate at which the noise envelope returns to 0V
Sets the main pitch of the drum, from C0 to C4
Sets the time the pitch envelope takes: counter-clockwise gives a more aggressive percussive sound, clockwise gives stranger drum sounds
Adds a gradual distortion to the oscillator until it becomes very punchy
Sets the character of the noise: counter-clockwise a pink-like noise that suits snares, clockwise a noise without low frequencies that suits hi hats
Blends the internal oscillator with the signal at the oscillator's EXT IN jack
Blends the internal noise with the signal at the noise section's EXT IN jack
Sets the oscillator envelope's transition times: SLOW for longer transitions and a less snappy envelope, FAST for a snappier one
Sets the noise envelope's transition times: SLOW for longer transitions and a less snappy envelope, FAST for a snappier one
Reduces the sample rate of the noise, which makes glitchy percussion sounds
Attenuates and inverts the oscillator section's modulation input before it reaches the chosen parameter
Attenuates and inverts the noise section's modulation input before it reaches the chosen parameter
Steps through the parameters of the oscillator section, picking which one the oscillator modulation input changes
Steps through the parameters of the noise section, picking which one the noise modulation input changes

inputs.text: A signal above 2V triggers the drum
An external oscillator to blend into the oscillator section
An external signal to blend into the noise section
A control voltage for the parameter chosen in the oscillator section, scaled by its attenuverter
A control voltage for the parameter chosen in the noise section, scaled by its attenuverter

outputs.text: The pitch CV of the internal oscillator, shaped by BEND, for driving an external oscillator whose signal comes back into EXT IN
The envelope of the oscillator section
The envelope of the noise section
